svg.title: G4 - Polar Halo
svg.desc: The Sombrero galaxy creates an icy luminous halo and a sweeping dust lane inside the approved Kosmos mark. Preview only.
svg.metadata: Texture: NASA/STScI/AURA, PIA15226. Source: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/PIA15226/PIA15226~medium.jpg. Artistic crop and recoloring.
